status: fixed before first full-SEED model run
hypothesis: Fixed-eight-channel log power or covariance provides participant-independent information for SEED positive/neutral/negative classification
falsification: Participant bootstrap uncertainty overlaps the 1/3 balanced-accuracy baseline; no evidence for deployment from this experiment
subjects: 1-15, all three sessions each; leave one entire participant out
labels: -1 negative, 0 neutral, 1 positive; provided trial labels, not instantaneous wearer reports
windows: 12 seconds non-overlapping; discard first 2 seconds for causal filter warmup and incomplete tail per trial
filter: fourth-order Butterworth SOS causal, reset at each movie trial; upstream supplied SEED preprocessing remains offline
features: log variance and matrix-log regularized covariance; band-major; covariance += 0.05*trace(C)/8*I

models.power_lda: train-only StandardScaler then lsqr LDA, shrinkage auto, equal class priors
models.power_hgb: 100 iterations, .1 learning rate, 15 leaf nodes, min leaf 30, L2=1, class-balanced sample weights, early_stopping=false, seed=20260926

budget: 45 fits, fixed hyperparameters; deterministic methods with no subsampling; no target-person adaptation
secondary: participant accuracy, macro-F1 and confusion matrix; paired bootstrap comparisons to power_lda
statistics: participant bootstrap 20000 resamples, seed 20260926; 95% mean intervals, 97.5% paired intervals for two comparisons; exploratory model comparison, not separate heldout confirmation
limitations: shared videos across people; not unseen-stimulus validation
reference and acquisition differ from Cyton
12-second data window is not execution latency
not directly comparable with DEAP or GAMEEMO label tasks
